verdict.rationale: Modal's own marketing says sandboxes spin up "in seconds" (hundreds of thousands of concurrent environments) and are "built for the latency" consumer AI products need. Release notes describe an opt-in backend with substantially higher creation rates. These are aggregate-scale, marketing-level claims rather than documented per-sandbox cold-start figures. Missing for 10: explicit documented cold-start latency numbers (sub-second or few-second per sandbox), benchmark or measurement docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of startup times.
